description: This file defines the 'Article' controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing tasks related to adding, editing, and deleting articles. It primarily adds tasks to a task scheduler for each CRUD operation on articles.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class handling article-related events and task scheduling for article CRUD operations within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Creates tasks to list articles and retrieve info for a newly added article, based on output parameter.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Creates tasks to list articles and retrieve info for an edited article, based on args parameter.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Creates tasks to list articles and delete a specified article, based on args parameter.
